name: Ashikaga Inori
source: A girl who bumps into Setsuna on her first day at Radish Restaurant. After being knockout by Setsuna(for accidently stripping her uniform) she is looked after by her. She is the long lost childhood friend of Makoto. She is a close friend of Otome. Her biological parents are Natsuhi and Shun.
